what: Pass-down for picking up on FADI's MacBook at the venue: router reset recovery, SSH to the Jetson, the one-adapter-owner rule with Table 10, and what to show
why: The Jetson kit is connected at the venue, but the travel router was factory reset and the MacBook has no Jetson key yet. A new session needs one page to get going without endangering the live Table 10 demo.
details: Priority order before 3 PM: live Table 10 demo, backup recording, submission, then the Jetson. Table 10's real-arm service holds both USB-CAN adapters, so nothing else may open them; switching to the handoff/ path is a team decision. After the reset the Beryl is at 192.168.8.1 with the label Wi-Fi, earlier address reservations are gone, and the Jetson rejoins by DHCP. The MacBook needs its own SSH key authorized on the Jetson (FADI types the password; host key SHA256:1Re9L+dbMLneresWeHhOM37nO2PW7a3mjuEhyHNGvvk). Includes a starter prompt for the new session.
